source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 10 mathematics textbooks (advanced stream)

stages.headline: Functions can be added, subtracted, multiplied and divided: f(x) = x², g(x) = x + 1 ⇒ (f + g)(x) = x² + x + 1, (f · g)(x) = x³ + x².
stages.headlineEnglish: Functions can be added, subtracted, multiplied and divided: f(x) = x², g(x) = x + 1 ⇒ (f + g)(x) = x² + x + 1, (f · g)(x) = x³ + x².

stages.headline: Composition f(g(x)) feeds the value of g into f: f(g(x)) = (x + 1)², while g(f(x)) = x² + 1.
stages.headlineEnglish: Composition f(g(x)) feeds the value of g into f: f(g(x)) = (x + 1)², while g(f(x)) = x² + 1.

stages.headline: The domain of f ± g and f · g is the intersection of the domains; for f/g also remove the points where g(x) = 0.
stages.headlineEnglish: The domain of f ± g and f · g is the intersection of the domains; for f/g also remove the points where g(x) = 0.
